title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at Interpro - NSW (Sydney, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Business Analyst - Large Telco in Sydney Job As a BA you will provide support on activities associated with Customer Experience improvement programs within Residential Sales and Marketing and Business Sales and Marketing. Responsibilities: Gather business requirements through interaction/ workshops with both internal and external stakeholders and obtain sign off from appropriate stakeholders Analyse gaps between needs and current capabilities. Work with external stakeholders to understand and investigate feedback into the service/function/product provided Contribute to business cases that describe and justify the parameters of CX and technology change initiatives. Facilitate and contribute towards the arrival of appropriate business solution. Participate in technical reviews and inspections to verify that the design is carried throughout each phase of project. Use data modelling practices to analyse impact of changes delivered throughout the company to CX and recommendation on measures we need to take to get back on track Use data modelling practices to analyse your findings and create suggestions for strategic and operational improvements Develop plans for monitoring and control of program benefits delivery including market research activities Ensure that appropriate communication methods are used to achieved shared understanding of, and agreement to, the solution requirements Working with the Program Team and relevant stakeholders to develop Information Needs Analysis documents describing required change that accurately reflects stated Experience: Strong analytical skills applied to understanding business functionality and translating them into business requirements Ability to create compelling business cases with accurate cost and effort estimations. Ability to understand business complexity project interdependencies Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and changing business requirements Experience in a Telecommunications environment. 8 years experience in general business analysis in a large enterprise. Record of working with senior Business stakeholders and IT teams to obtain alignment on approach and ongoing communication of delivery risks and status. Ability to facilitate workshops and drive required outcomes Analysis, problem / data / systems / process / business / strategic business Investigation and validation, e.g. business needs / requirements Solution validation and verification Requirements / Story management tools (e.g. JIRA, Rational Suite, Focal Point) Business case / tender preparation MS Office: Outlook, Powerpoint, Word, Excel data input & analysis. Exposure to Visualisations and Big Data is highly desirable. What's on Offer? - Initial 6 month contract Possible extension - $800 - $1150pd inc Super GST Apply today If you meet ALL of the requirement named above, please click on the apply button or send your resume to annmarie.f@interpropeople.com
